author: Ankit
problem: Read Q queries on an initially empty list: '1 x' appends x to the end, and '2 k' prints the k-th value from the end. Print the answers to the type-2 queries, one per line.
bug_description: Appends the query type (always 1) instead of the value x.

comments.accurate: Processes append and k-th-from-the-end queries on a growing list
comments.wrong_behavior: Type-1 queries record their first field; type-2 queries print the k-th recorded value from the end
comments.wrong_location: Append step verified; check the negative index when k equals the list length
